stream.record_header: little-endian IHHHIIIIIHH: ordinal, beforePC, visiblePC, afterPC, before_frame, visible_frame, after_frame, visible_cycles, interval_cycles, audio_write_count, completed_frame_count
stream.snapshots: before, visible_end, after: A/X/Y/P/SP bytes then all128 canonical RAM bytes each
stream.raster: Explicitly partial visible_end viewport, then EVERY completed physical frame in timestamp/frame order; no implicit crop or frame loss
stream.video_header: little-endian IHHHH: source-cycle offset, width160, height1..320, start_line0..320, scanlines1..1024; followed by width*height raw indexed bytes
stream.startup: Seeded RIOT startup may span multiple physical frames; bounded interval <=524288 sourcecycles, not assumed steady cadence
stream.normalization: Native Stella viewport is retained. Mapping to the approved210-row graphics domain requires separately measured alignment and black-omission validation; partial/unstable startup video is explicitly identified
stream.legacy_v1: FBPR0001 parser retained for original-free protocol tests only; its210-row raster has strict nonblack-omission rejection
stream.audio_write: little-endian IBB: normalized source-cycle offset, decoded TIA audio write address15..1A, unmodified bus value
stream.audio_order: Retain every ordered write, including unchanged values and silent intervals; no deduplication
stream.terminator: FBPRDONE then little-endian uint32 record_count; no trailing bytes

evidence_policy: Independent original raster/audio observations, controlled fixtures, natural input-only replay, target pixels/events/state, manual review and physical acceptance remain separate
status: Source observation protocol/parser under implementation; backend and actual source acceptance pending
